map.租期（起止/续签）提醒 使用指南: Lease Term and Renewal Reminder Guide
map.按本地日历日计算租约剩余天数并分级预警；页面关闭后不会主动推送，可导出 .ics: Count remaining lease days by local calendar date with tiered alerts; there is no background push after the page closes, but you can export .ics for a local calendar.
map.登记租约起止与续签状态，按本地日历日计算剩余天数并分级预警；支持导出 .ics: Record lease dates and renewal status, count remaining days by local calendar date and show tiered alerts; export .ics calendar reminders, with no background push after the page closes.
map.填写房产地址、租客、月租金、租期开始与结束日期；电话可选。: Enter the property address, tenant, monthly rent and lease start/end dates; phone is optional.
map.点「添加租约」，列表按剩余天数升序排列并着色。: Click Add Lease; the list sorts by remaining days and is color-coded.
map.用「待沟通/已续签/不续签」记录续签状态。: Use To discuss / Renewed / Not renewing to record renewal status.
map.点「导出日历提醒(.ics)」导入本地日历，由日历应用在到期前 30 天提醒。: Click Export calendar reminder (.ics) and import it into your local calendar; the calendar app alerts 30 days before expiry.
map.多套出租房集中管理到期与续签状态。: Manage expiry and renewal status across multiple rentals in one place.
map.跨时区或夏令时地区核对剩余天数是否与本地日历一致。: In other time zones or DST regions, check that remaining days match the local calendar.
map.把租约导入手机日历，避免只靠打开网页查看。: Import leases into a phone calendar instead of relying on opening the web page.
map.租期至 2026-10-05，在 2026-09-20 查看：按本地日历日相减剩: Lease ends 2026-10-05; viewed on 2026-09-20 the local-calendar difference is 15 days, shown as an orange “due in 15 days”. The old method could show 14 days in UTC−8; this page parses year-month-day directly. In the exported .ics, VALARM fires 30 days before expiry.
map.关闭页面后没有后台推送能力；日期按本地年月日解析，不受 UTC 偏移与夏令时影响: There is no background push after the page closes; dates are parsed as local year-month-day and are unaffected by UTC offsets or DST; data stays in this browser and is lost if browser data is cleared.
map.关闭页面还会提醒吗？: Will it still remind me after I close the page?
map.不会。需要主动提醒请导出 .ics 并导入本地日历。: No. For active reminders, export .ics and import it into your local calendar.
map.跨时区会偏差吗？: Will time zones cause a mismatch?
map.不会。日期拆成年月日并用日序号相减，不经过本地时刻。: No. Dates are split into year-month-day and subtracted as day numbers, without passing through local clock time.
map.浏览器本地，不上传服务器；清理浏览器数据会丢失。: In this browser locally, not uploaded; clearing browser data will lose it.
